_what: The shared banned-word list for ship-ready-baseline (row 18): words that read as machine-written on any page, screen or email. From Peace Be Still's phase-1 UI list (app/src/quality/banned.json), minus its brand-only words (urban, space, journey, speak life, your faith companion); exact words, so 'elevated' or 'seamlessly' are not hits; a repo adds its own in ship-ready.json "words". Regex fragments, matched case-insensitively on whole words of the visible text.
